thread:
tori: Quick ping  saw a weird spike in unassigned leads last night around the DST changeover (02:00 local). ~7% of late-night leads didn't enter RR. Anyone else see a timezone-related flake? :confused:

devin: yes. HubSpot webhook payloads during the DST forward hour had created_at timestamps that shifted an hour forward. Our RR window check uses `created_at` in local tz which caused some leads to miss the night-window rules.

marco: on top of that, external enrichment p95 went up to 45s for that hour due to vendor maintenance, so combined effect == more unassigned.

ops-bot: Alert: enrichment-gateway maintenance window overlap detected 2024-11-03T01:50Z-2024-11-03T02:20Z. 21 webhook retries observed.

tori: immediate fixes proposed: 1) treat HubSpot timestamps as UTC in routing checks 2) bump claim TTL to 50s for DST transition window 3) run backfill for leads created between 01:50-02:30 local. Which is low-risk?

devin: treating HS timestamps as UTC is safe and idempotent; I'll deploy a small parsing patch now. Command: `infractl set parsing.hubspot.use_utc true --env prod --canary 5%`

marco: I'll flip claim TTL to 50s for the window and start backfill job. Backfill plan: query leads where created_at within the DST window OR tag `tz-ambiguous`, re-run enrichment idempotently, then push to RR.

crm-bot: HubSpot webhook batch shows mixed tz offsets: some events had -07:00 while others had -08:00 during the hour.

tori: messaging for sales: "We had a small routing gap during the DST changeover plus an enrichment vendor maintenance; affected late-night leads have been reprocessed and assignment restored. If you notice missing leads, DM us."

devin: parsing patch deployed to canary, looks good (no downstream errors). Will roll to 100% after 30m.

marco: backfill kicked: job bf-20241103-dst-01. Processed 320 leads -> 295 into RR, 25 to overflow. No duplicates.

ops-bot: claim TTL override applied for 01:40-02:40 local window.

tori: long-term items: - normalize all inbound timestamps to UTC at ingress - add DST transition test to webhooks e2e - dynamic claim TTL that reads vendor p95 at runtime - add a \"tz-ambiguous\" tag auto-detection and auto-backfill flow

devin: filing tickets for those. Marking incident P3 (SLA blip).

tori: thanks team. I'll post the postmortem draft later today and ping sales with the finalized blurb. Closing thread after postmortem link is attached. :white_check_mark:
